events.title: Darkest Path is in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has begun, and Darkest Path is part of it.We haven't posted here in a while because most of our time has gone into polishing the demo and getting it as close as possible to how we want the full game to feel. This isn't just a small prototype anymore. The demo includes the core combat systems, enemies, abilities, path choices, altars, NPC encounters and the boss of the first chapter.Over the last few weeks we've also been watching people play the demo for the first time. events.title: The Darkest Path Playtest is Now Closed
events.summary: It has been exactly one week, and we are officially closing the doors on this early playtest.First off, I want to say a massive thank you to everyone who played and took the time to leave feedback. To be completely honest, we never expected this much attention. We opened this build just to do a very small, quiet run to see if the core gameplay loop was actually fun. events.title: We just hit a major milestone: 100 Organic Wishlists! 🎉
events.summary: It may seem like a small number, but for us, it's incredibly meaningful. We haven't launched any official marketing yet, so every single one of you found Darkest Path through your own curiosity. Thank you for joining us on this descent so early in the journey!To make things even better, we recently celebrated our lead artist’s birthday. His mother surprised him with this amazing, blood-dripping Darkest Path cake!Seeing our dark, gritty world turned into a handmade gift was a truly special moment
